description: No individual CSFP Sangguniang Panlungsod Resolution currently meets the project's verified-record threshold. This is an intentionally empty verified dataset, not proof that CSFP has no resolutions: it means no individual numbered SP Resolution legal record was successfully recovered and independently verified from an authoritative CSFP source in the current public-source research pass. Candidates, probable non-SP local issuances, unverified range/period claims, source-recovery leads, and rejected external/wrong-issuing-body examples are tracked separately in data/legislation/resolution-recovery-queue.json and must never be promoted here without primary-source evidence (an official signed Resolution, official SP journal/minutes, an official Resolution registry/index, or an official CSFP page citing the exact number and issuing body).
